title: Promotions & discounts
subtitle: Create automatic campaigns and scheduled coupons with flexible conditions.
name: Promotion

form.setupIntro: Build the promotion step by step: name it, choose the discount, then decide where and when it applies.
form.generalTip: Use a customer-friendly name, such as: 15% off pizza.
form.languageHelp: The promotion name is shown to customers in the menu. Arabic is used in Arabic mode and English in English mode. Descriptions are not displayed, so they were removed from this form.
form.typeTip: Choose one promotion type. Only the fields required for that type will appear.
form.conditionsTip: All conditions are optional. Leave a field empty when you do not need that restriction.
form.targetTip: Choose what receives the promotion. Entire order applies the discount to the cart total.
form.scheduleTip: Leave dates and times empty for an always-on promotion, and select no weekdays to run every day.
form.activateNowHelp: The promotion becomes visible after saving when its dates and conditions are valid.
form.saveDraftHelp: Saves the promotion in the dashboard without showing it to customers.
form.limitsTip: For a simple promotion, leave limits empty and enable auto apply. Add a coupon only when customers must enter a code.
form.reviewTip: Review the summary, then choose Active to start now or Draft to save without showing it to customers.
form.fixedHelp: Deducts a fixed amount, for example EGP 30.
form.buyGetHelp: The customer receives free units after buying a quantity, for example buy 2 get 1.
form.freeItemHelp: Adds a free product when the conditions are met.
form.freeDeliveryHelp: Removes the delivery fee when the conditions are met.
form.name: English name
form.allDay: No operating hours selected: the promotion runs all day during the selected dates and weekdays.
form.statusHelp: Nothing is saved until you press Save promotion below.
form.failed: Could not save the promotion. Check the data.
form.invalidTarget: Choose a valid product, category, or branch for this promotion.
form.couponExists: This coupon code is already in use. Choose another code.

checkout.invalid: The coupon is invalid or does not apply to this order.
checkout.COUPON_USAGE_LIMIT: This coupon has reached its usage limit.
checkout.COUPON_CUSTOMER_LIMIT: You have reached your limit for this coupon.
checkout.COUPON_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Your order does not meet this coupon's conditions.
